# voipms_ring_groups (Data Source)

Lists ring groups (`getRingGroups`).


## Example Usage

```terraform
data "voipms_ring_groups" "all" {}

output "ring_group_names" {
  value = [for g in data.voipms_ring_groups.all.ring_groups : g.name]
}
```


<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier (`ring_groups`).
- `ring_groups` (Attributes List) Ring groups on this account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ring_groups))

<a id="nestedatt--ring_groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ring_groups`

Read-Only:

- `caller_announcement` (String) Recording code played to the caller.
- `id` (String) Ring group id.
- `language` (String) Language for system messages.
- `members` (Attributes List) Destinations rung by this group, in order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ring_groups--members))
- `music_on_hold` (String) Music on hold class.
- `name` (String) Ring group name.
- `route` (String) DID routing value (`grp:{id}`). Use this for `voipms_did` `routing` / failover.
- `voicemail` (String) Mailbox that takes the call when nobody answers.

<a id="nestedatt--ring_groups--members"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ring_groups.members`

Read-Only:

- `press1` (Boolean) Member must press 1 to connect.
- `ring_time` (Number) Seconds this member rings.
- `route` (String) Member route (`account:` or `fwd:`).
